title: Vibrant, Savory Moroccan Garlic Sellou
description: Garlicky, molten, comforting moroccan dish featuring soy sauce. Traditionally served in a dolsot stone bowl, this recipe is a delicious twist on a classic.
instructions: Crush the garlic cloves using a mortar and pestle until you get a smooth paste.
In a small bowl, mix together soy sauce, olive oil, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
In a large mortar, heat the soy sauce mixture over medium heat until fragrant.
Add the garlic paste to the soy sauce mixture and stir well.
Add chopped parsley and cilantro to the mixture and stir well.
Transfer the mixture to a dolsot stone bowl or a similar heatproof vessel.
If using feta cheese, crumble it on top of the mixture.
Place the bowl under a broiler or in a 400°F oven for 5 minutes, or until the mixture is hot and bubbly.
Remove the bowl from the heat and let it cool slightly before serving.
Garnish with additional parsley and cilantro if desired.
